overview_description.description: Courtyard is a platform that provides liquidity to collectible assets via physically backed NFTs. It allows ownership of physical collectibles to be instantly and securely transferred anywhere in the world via NFTs, without the physical item itself having to be moved. Connected Collectibles - a new, frictionless way of storing and trading physical goods - is redefining physical asset ownership.

about_short_description.short_description: Courtyard is an online marketplace for trading cards & digital packs

product.name: Courtyard Marketplace
product.description: An online marketplace for buying and selling graded basketball, baseball, football, and Pokémon trading cards linked to digital collectibles.

product.name: Courtyard Digital Packs
product.description: Digital packs that users open online to reveal associated physical trading cards, including sports and Pokémon collectibles.

product.name: Physical Card Redemption
product.description: A service that enables holders of eligible digital collectibles to redeem the corresponding physical trading cards for delivery worldwide.

product.name: Vaulted and Insured Card Storage
product.description: A storage service for keeping physical trading cards in a vaulted and insured environment while they remain available through the platform.

product.name: Submit Your Collection
product.description: A collection submission service for presenting trading-card collections to Courtyard for potential inclusion or handling through its platform.
